liquidityMagnet.note: Honest caveat first: both magnets sit within 52.5 points of spot, so as DISTANCE they are noise - the useful content is direction, not proximity. Direction says down. The measured window is a 90.0 percent SHORT-side flush, 675,046 USD of the 750,290 USD total, the exact mirror of the 99.2 percent long-side flush endday measured six hours earlier. But open interest ROSE 0.93 percent through it, from 2,242,287,825 to 2,263,240,604 USD, and the 1H long/short account ratio went UP from 1.55 to 1.59 while funding stayed positive at plus 0.0000660. Shorts were squeezed out and longs took their place in greater number than before. Crowding is on the long side again and it is the crowded side that gets hunted, which is why the pull reads down even while price grinds up.
